summary: Secure Access Control & Approval-Based Registration System for CloudStorage. Features: Internet Identity authentication, auto Super Admin promotion for first user, Pending Approval flow for subsequent users, Admin Dashboard with Role & Access Management and User Management tabs, RBAC permission matrix, detailed audit logs, configurable storage quotas. Currently attempting simplified Step 1: User Registration with Pending Approval (Internet Identity login, first user becomes Super Admin, pending status for others, basic admin approval panel).
architectural_notes: Build is failing repeatedly — breaking into Step 1 first: login + pending approval + basic admin panel, then adding RBAC/audit/quota in later steps
Authentication via Internet Identity (passkey, Google, Apple, Microsoft)
First registered user auto-promoted to Super Admin (one-time only); all others start as Pending
known_issues: Repeated AI build failures when attempting full-scope build — simplifying to incremental steps

existing_features.title: After a user logs in via Internet Identity, check their registration status. If their status is Pending, display a full-screen waiting screen informing them that their account is awaiting admin approval. If their status is Rejected, display a full-screen rejection notice. If their status is Active or SuperAdmin, allow normal app access. If they are new (not yet registered), register them and then route based on the assigned status.

Add a basic Admin Panel page accessible only to the SuperAdmin. This page must display a table of all registered users showing their principal ID, display name (if set), and current status. The SuperAdmin must be able to approve or reject each Pending user directly from this table using action buttons.

new_feature_requests.summary: Internet Identity authentication (passkey, Google, Apple, Microsoft sign-in)
Auto Super Admin promotion for the first registered/verified user (only once)
Pending Approval registration flow — all subsequent users wait for admin approval before login
Admin Dashboard: Role & Access Management tab — create/manage roles (Super Admin, Admin, Manager, User, Custom), RBAC permission matrix, privilege escalation protection, confirmation modals

Admin Dashboard: User Management tab — full user table with filters (Pending/Active/Suspended/Rejected), approve/reject, assign roles & storage quotas (GB), suspend/deactivate, search & sort, role badges
Detailed audit log with before/after values for every key action (approvals, role changes, promotions, quota changes) including timestamp and actor
Configurable storage quotas (GB) per user — displayed and assigned via admin dashboard

Add a user registration status system to the backend. Each registered principal must have a status field with possible values: SuperAdmin, Active, Pending, Rejected, Suspended. When the very first user logs in and registers, automatically assign them SuperAdmin status. All subsequent users who log in for the first time must be assigned Pending status.
